descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Build the world, one piece at a time. **Puzzles of the World** brings the joy of building wooden miniatures to beautiful places you can explore.

**Build Miniatures**

Bring iconic landmarks and charming scenes to life, from Kyoto’s Yasaka Pagoda to the Eiffel Tower and the Taj Mahal. Discover the satisfaction of assembling intricate wooden miniatures, piece by piece.

[media]

**Relax and Explore**

Step away from the table and explore beautifully stylized destinations. Unwind with atmospheric sounds and an original soundtrack by Markus Zierhofer of AudioCreatures.

[media]

**Take In the Details**

Discover detailed patterns, warm wood textures, and laser-cut edges as each miniature comes together. Lean in to explore the custom-built designs, from ornate rooftops to tiny windows and doorways.

[media]

**Switch Between Day and Night**

Choose your preferred time of day and see each destination in a new light. Find your favorite view, settle in, and enjoy the satisfaction of seeing your miniatures take shape, one piece at a time.

[media]

**Play Your Way**

Build with the precision of Quest controllers or the natural feel of hand tracking. Pick up, turn, and place each piece using whichever feels most comfortable to you.

[media]

**In Your Space**

Turn your favorite spot at home into a peaceful building space with mixed reality. Keep your surroundings in view as you assemble puzzles right in front of you.

[media]
